#399 fix r3.summary:
Round 3 of #399 is done as one amended commit, ab7d6a02, on 8428e16c in /tmp/wt-399. Nothing was pushed. Main moved to 31681046 (#379) while I worked, so the commit is no longer on main's tip.
(0) Rebased onto 8428e16c. The conflicts were in ADR-0199's status lines (both kept) and in README's ADR-0199 row (the #399 sentence added after #178's text).
(1) The /extension new placement question and the /agents run project-agent confirm now call ext_ui.select_declared(..., own=True). select_declared passes a keyword only to a select that declares it. The sweep of packages/*/src found no other aelix-written call through runtime.ui. test_own_pickers_marked now scans every product file (28 call-site rows plus 2 checks).
(2) New rows check that a dialog recovers from too-small for select and confirm, both when the title is then drawn whole and when it scrolls.
(3) Titles wrap by grapheme cluster. New width.py functions: graphemes (from wcwidth.iter_graphemes, with wcwidth>=0.3.0 declared in the [tui] extra), cluster_cells and cells_by_cluster. The shared approval_dialog._cut no longer splits a cluster. A cluster ending in a zero-width character is kept off the last column, because prompt-toolkit drops the mark there (measured).
(4) The rows under a title are parsed as one ANSI text, as on main, so a label with a newline takes two rows. The space left for options is counted in screen rows.
(5) The CHANGELOG, ADR-0253 11.3 and the README row now say the counter shows only while there is a row for it, and the too-small sentence lists every key that answers.
(6) A new row checks that PgDn presses with no repaint release nothing.

blocking.title: The new last-column pad in cells_by_cluster has no test, and a mutant without it stays green
blocking.detail: I removed ends_row=True from the last cluster in tui/width.py cells_by_cluster, which is the check _title_rows uses to decide a line fits. The narrow and broad sets both stay green (tests/tui, agents_ext, builtin, extensions, cli, agents: 9034 passed). Under that mutant, a title exactly as wide as the window that ends in a combining mark ('x'*79 + e+U+0301 at 80 columns) is kept on one row. prompt-toolkit drops the mark on the last column, so the screen shows a bare e, and Enter answers. That is the item-3 defect class: the question on screen is not the one asked. test_a_cluster_at_the_wrap_is_never_split[79-e] puts ' tail end' after the cluster, so it only exercises _cut and never this fit path. Fix: add one row. _title_rows('x'*79 + e+U+0301, 80) must be 2 rows, and the painted select must keep the accent.
